terms.comment: In Justinian’s Code a public almshouse for poor old people (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: Traupman’s nursing home; in late Latin a hospital
terms.comment: Greek νοσοκομεῖον is a hospital or infirmary; for a home for the old use gerontocomīum, which Traupman himself gives for old-age home.

sources: Lewis & Short: gerontocomium · Lewis & Short: nosocomium
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 65, checked against the searchable text of the book.
